Score Up!

At the park one weekend...

nodes.text: So, $ZOE, what do you think? You like nature, and this is very... Nature-y.

...And find a small fountain, teeming with tiny ducklings!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: One phone call isn't going to hurt... Right?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Hey, you know how I feel about this. If it were me, I'd call...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: But I also know that you guys made a pact. You made it for a reason, and you should probably keep it.
$ZOE tries to resist calling Howard, but the temptation is strong...
$ZOE resists the urge...
Score Up!

nodes.text: This is so tough...
She turns her phone completely off.
At the first football game...
The cheerleaders are huddled near the sideline.

nodes.speaker: Announcer
nodes.text: Will the Captains please come out to the center of the football field for the coin toss?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who are the Captains now that Howard's gone?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Who do you think?

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: I think they're all Captains!
Spencer walks out onto the football field...
With Nate right behind him!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nate? But isn't he new?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: `New` doesn't matter when you're a stud quarterback!
nodes.text_bbcode: [color=#3b78e2][i]New[/i][/color] doesn't matter when you're a stud quarterback!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Nate! Nate! Nate!

$ZOE walks away from the cheerleading team and takes out her phone...
$ZOE takes a deep breath.

Ben raises his hand.

Miss Prez makes a face at Ben as she walks toward her book bag.

nodes.text: It's been so painful watching you have to go through heartbreak after heartbreak.

nodes.text: I don't like it when you get hurt.

nodes.text: The trick to getting over someone is to occupy your time. To distract you from thinking about Howard.

nodes.text: Sorry. I guess I understand. If you're going to quit something, do it cold turkey, right?

nodes.text: Yeah... I think this is the only way. If Howard and I were calling each other all the time, I think it would just feel like we were breaking up really slowly.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But it's hard. I mean, I really miss him.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I know what that's like. I still miss Nick...

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: These smell delicious!
Suddenly, $ZOE starts crying!

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I mean... These smell... Bad?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... It's just that Howard used to be the one who helped me with cookies.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.text: Instead you got burned!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I guess I just misunderstood... I'm sorry. I haven't been in the best of moods lately.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, that's okay. These things happen. Anyway, I'll be around.

nodes.text: Maybe not, Manda-Panda. Your pie is dangerous.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: That doesn't mean I love it any less...

nodes.text: Let's face it. Without $ZOE's cookies, this bake sale is a disaster.

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Is this a joke? Hot pepper pie and coal cakes?

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: My nightmare... It's coming true!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: I'm crazy hungry for some $ZOE cookies too. I could probably eat `a thousand` of them!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sorry, Spence... But we don't have any cookies.
A voice calls from the back of the pack of football players.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Then we'll take all the $ZOE cookies you're `planning` on baking.
nodes.text_bbcode: Then we'll take all the $ZOE cookies you're [color=#e23b3b][i]planning[/i][/color] on baking.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nate?

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Whoa... Who's the hottie?
Nicole leans in, whispering...

nodes.text: Transfer from Spartan Academy. Just joined the football team. Quarterback.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: You're going to buy cookies I haven't even made yet?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Seems like you're in a jam. Thought I'd help out.
Nate pulls out a bunch of cash from his wallet and hands them to $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: For however many cookies that buys us.

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Future cookies...?

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Awesome!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Nate!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: Yeah, Hot Guy will buy bracelets for all of us!

nodes.speaker: Nate

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uhhhh...
Maria nudges $ZOE with her elbow.

nodes.text: What are you waiting for?! Give him your number!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Mine too!

nodes.text: What? Just in case.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm... I'm sorry, Nate, but I can't give you my number...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: See? Take mine instead!

nodes.speaker: Zach
nodes.text: Booooooo!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: It's just that...

nodes.text: Really? You're trying to compliment me on these?

nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.text: I don't think anyone should eat them though.

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Not if they want to keep all their teeth!

nodes.text: Uh, $ZOE, where are all the cookies you baked?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, I, uh... I didn't feel like baking anything.
The cheerleaders turn to $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Maria
nodes.text: What?! You didn't bake `any` cookies?!

nodes.speaker: Jill
nodes.text: But you `always` bake something.
nodes.text_bbcode: But you [color=#3b78e2][i]always[/i][/color] bake something.

nodes.text: How are we supposed to have a bake sale without your cookies?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Who?

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: She's being really stingy with the dance money. I bet she's spending it all on herself...

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: I mean... That's what I'd do.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do we even need this money for?

nodes.text: Hey, they `could` look nice.

nodes.text_bbcode: It's not like it matters anymore! There is still the tiny problem of actually [color=#3b78e2][i]selling[/i][/color] something at this bake sale!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Well... What did you guys bake?

nodes.text: I tried to bake my mom's cupcakes, but I got distracted, and they... Caught fire.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Those look...

nodes.text: It `is` red! The same color as my hair!
nodes.text_bbcode: It [color=#3b78e2][i]is[/i][/color] red! The same color as my hair!

nodes.text: Good call. This morning, I told her it looked tasty...

nodes.text: Before I could blink, she had already shoved some into my mouth!

nodes.text: So spicy my tongue felt like it was sweating.

nodes.text: No prob.

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Thanks! Want a bite?!
Before $ZOE can react, Amanda shoves a piece of pie into her mouth!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hmmph!

nodes.speaker: Amanda
nodes.text: Your eyes water with joy when you eat it!
Amanda walks away, smiling blankly. As soon as she's gone, $ZOE spits out the pie!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I can't fee ma tong!

nodes.text_bbcode: I [color=#e23b3b][i]tried[/i][/color] to warn you. She did the same thing to me this morning!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Theeriouthly, Ector! Ma tong!

nodes.text: Heh. Don't worry, the effect will wear off soon.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Phew! That was the worst!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Uh... Tasty?
Nate's fists unclench...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh...
He straightens his tie.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm sorry, man... I just... I saw you with $ZOE, and...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah, I'm sorry.

nodes.text: Whatever.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I think I'd like to go home now...

After a quiet ride back to $ZOE's house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Nate.
$ZOE quickly opens her door to leave.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: $ZOE, wait, please? At least let me walk you to your front door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Okay...
Nate steps out of the car, walks around, and holds $ZOE's door open for her.
He walks her up to the front door...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Except for that last part of the dance, I had a really fun time with you tonight.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, what happened? You kind of... Snapped.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I have to confess... I've got a temper. I try to stay calm, but I never know what's going to set it off.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Seeing you with another guy... It just scared me, I guess.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Scared you?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah... Until then I didn't realize `how much` I wanted this to be a perfect evening.
nodes.text_bbcode: Yeah... Until then I didn't realize [color=#e23b3b][i]how much[/i][/color] I wanted this to be a perfect evening.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Even though we went as friends?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Heh. Well, there's always the hope that friends... Will become more than friends.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What are you saying?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm saying that I know a good thing when I see it. And I know we're a good thing.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: How do you know that?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Because of the way you smile when you're around me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Nate...

nodes.text: Am I wrong? Have you even thought about Howard tonight?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Howard?! Ohmygosh! I can't believe I completely forgot about Howard!

nodes.text: I... I haven't.

nodes.text: I didn't think so...

nodes.text: I'm telling you, $ZOE. We'd make a great team. What do you say?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey, Cuz!

nodes.text: I haven't seen you this happy in a long time!

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.text_bbcode: I haven't seen [color=#3b78e2][i]everyone[/i][/color] this happy in a long time!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: It's all because of you, $ZOE.

nodes.text: Well, that and because we're a shoo-in to make it to the State Championships this year.

nodes.speaker: Sam

nodes.speaker: Zoe

A slow song plays...
Nate slides forward, slipping his hands around $ZOE's waist.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: This okay?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah. Yeah, it is. It's a dance, right?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Exactly.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I know that we're here as friends and all, but I still feel like I should tell you...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I really like you, $ZOE.
$ZOE blushes...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know what to say.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That's okay. You don't have to say anything.

nodes.speaker: Nate

nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE.

nodes.text: I am. My girlfriend and I just broke up. I... I could use a friend.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Awww...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey! What do you think you're doing, pal?!

nodes.text: What?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: She's here with me!

nodes.text: Nate! Stop! You don't understand!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Keith...

nodes.text: Thanks, Nate. You're not looking so bad yourself.

nodes.text: I love your hair, too.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Really? I was actually thinking about changing it.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Oh yeah? I'm sure whatever you do with it will look good.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know... It just doesn't feel right, Nate.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Really? I mean, we're going to a dance, $ZOE.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: You're probably going to have to touch me at some point.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Right... I'm... I'm not used to this.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Hey, I get it. We'll ease into things.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Of course. I mean, we barely know each other anyway.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Thanks, Nate.
Nate holds open $ZOE's car door for her and closes it shut behind her. He smiles at her as she drives away.

The doorbell rings, and $ZOE stops for a second before opening the front door.

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: That's how it sounds.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I'm sorry... I think I just phrased it wrong.

nodes.speaker: Nate

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: To be honest, I'm so emotionally confused...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I don't know.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So you're saying you want to go as friends, is that it?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah, is that okay?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I think we'll have fun too!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Yeah?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.text: Has Nate asked you to the dance yet?

nodes.speaker: Zoe

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Oh, uh... Hey, Nate.

nodes.text: Thanks for all those cookies. The guys told me they would be worth the wait, and they were right.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: That's sweet of you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: What about you?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: What do you mean?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I'm just wondering if you're worth the wait too...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you comparing me to a cookie?!

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Am? I mean, cookies are sweet and delicious, and so far, I'm positive you're at least one of those things.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hee... Nate, cut it out.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Sorry, I couldn't help myself.
Nate walks with her towards her car.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Look, I know all about you and Howard. It sounds like you guys were special.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: So I totally understand if you don't want to go to the Homecoming Dance with me...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Are you asking me?

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: I am. Wanna go?

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I... I do...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But...

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: But I want to make sure that you understand why I'm going with you.

nodes.speaker: Nate
nodes.text: Well, I hope it's got something to do with you liking me...

nodes.speaker: Nate

nodes.text: The only guy for me is Howard! And if I can't date him, then I'll never date anyone ever again!

$ZOE shuffles her way through her house...

nodes.speaker: Zoe

$ZOE hears a sound in the far part of the house.

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Is that you, Howard?
A cat comes running into the room...

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mrow!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: There's my Howard! There he is! Awwwww!
$ZOE bends down and scoops Howard up, petting him lovingly.

nodes.speaker: Howard
nodes.text: Mrow mrow mrow! Purrrrr!
Somewhere inside $ZOE, she feels an unbearable sadness. For one brief instance, she stares into the distance...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: I wonder where the real Howard is...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: And when I became so... Alone?

nodes.text: Hey, $ZOE!

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Hey...

nodes.speaker: Zoe
nodes.text: Sam?! What are you doing here?!

nodes.speaker: Nicole
nodes.text: Yeah... Don't you have a pool to go flounder in?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Shut it, Nicole.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: I'm here because I'm fed up.

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: The reason that cheer didn't work is because of `you,` $ZOE!

nodes.text: I'm not talking about rhyming! I'm talking about how sad you are!

nodes.text_bbcode: When you're sad, they're sad. When you aren't cheerful, they can't be [color=#3b78e2][i]cheer[/i][/color]leaders!

nodes.text: So what am I supposed to do, Sam? You said I'm supposed to be sad and lonely for a while...

nodes.text: Oh, Sam...

nodes.text: ...That's why I'm telling you that I was wrong before.

nodes.text: Wrong about what?

nodes.speaker: Sam
nodes.text: Wrong about guys. I... I think you need to go out on a date with someone.

nodes.text: I can't do that!

nodes.text: Listen to me... I'm not saying that you need to date some guy and make out with him all night.
